region.description: The region where the oidc provider will be updated. Defaults to us-east-1 if not set.

role_arn.description: The ARN of the role to be assumed for this provider.

session_name.description: Session name which will be set for the assumed role.

client_id.description: The ClientID/Audience to be added to the OIDC provider.

oidc_arn.description: The target OIDC provider ARN where the ClientID should be added.

block.description: Resource for synching the audience/ClientID in the AWS OIDC providers. The official AWS provider does currently not support this feature therefore this resource.
